title: Page 2
content_zh:
“那只是举手之劳。”

她半吓起小嘴。“我知道，可我就是不喜欢。”

齐藤英树扯唇淡笑，没在这话题上继续下去。

蓝琳看着他，倒没傻到死死纠缠，她就是喜欢齐藤英树这冷冷淡淡的调调，百般应诺奉承的男人她还看不上眼，尤其现在两人的关系什么都不是，她勾着他的手，他没甩掉她，她就偷笑了。

另一头，席舞找到了左语恩，劈头便说：“你眼镜借我吧！”

左语恩递上水。“为什么突然……”

“因为我遇见一个不想遇见的熟人。”席舞接过水咕噜咕噜喝下，看着左语恩脸上的黑框眼镜。“仔细瞧你这眼镜没度数吧？用来遮点脸效果应该不错。可以借我吧？不然我要闪人了，专访恕我帮不上忙。”

“好没良心……”都已经知道这专访有多重要了，还说要闪人？看来席舞是真的遇上一个非常不想见的熟人，左语恩根本不能说不。嘴里念着，伸手已把脸上的眼镜给摘下来。“喏，给你。”

“谢啦。”席舞微笑接过，突然看了她一眼，眼睛倏地瞪大。“天啊，语恩，你长得很美耶，眼睛还会勾人……唔……”

左语恩用手封住了她的嘴。“嘘，别乱说话。”

席舞把她的手从嘴上给拔下来。“我哪有乱说，你真的很美啊。啧啧，那眼睛怕是男人一看见便会跌进去吧？”

“还说！”左语恩跺着脚。“眼镜还我！不借你了！”

她伸手要抢，席舞转身便躲，赶紧把眼镜戴在脸上。“来不及了，今天它已经属于我，除非你想让你的人物专访照片开天窗，我可是认真的！”

左语恩一听也不抢了，反倒把席舞转过身来看了看。“看起来差不多，你确定这样人家认不出来？”

“我会尽量躲在镜头后，不注意的话不会瞧见的。”席舞微笑地淡淡带过，不大顺手地扶了扶眼镜。“多了副眼镜。真的多了点安全感呢，难怪你老戴着眼镜，长得这么美，怕招来苍蝇？”

左语恩羞红了脸。“哪里美了？不过就是你平日以为我是个丑的，所以乍然看见觉得特别吃惊罢了。倒是你，刚刚是怎么一回事？怎么突然脸色发白？现在好些了吗？”

席舞点点头，不想解释什么，冲她一笑。“刚刚突然胸口疼，现在好多了，没事的，放心吧。”

“真没事那就工作去，今天就麻烦你了。”

“记得请我吃大餐就行。”席舞拍拍她，脸上尽是笑意，可心里头却是紧张万分的，心脏扑通扑通地跳，连掌心都要出汗了。

他会认出她来吗？

应该不会……

她真的不必自己吓自己……

签约仪式非常顺利，就是签了个名字，拿着麦克风对媒体说了一些照本宣科的场面话，顺便拍个照，让大家可以回去交差，齐藤英树对这些很熟悉，虽然不喜欢，可却应付自如。

酒会后的独家专访是蓝琳替他安排的，据说这间商业杂志社发行海内外，在台湾和大陆都颇具盛名及公信力，他会同意这个专访是出于对中日两家财团合作的宣传行销机制，宁缺勿滥。

可，他在受访时却显得十分心不在焉，因为他的目光一直被不远处拿着照相机的女人给吸引——

大大的黑框眼镜，几乎要遮住半张脸的刘海……转眼间，这女人似乎刻意地让自己变丑，究竟为什么？

他辨识人的眼光向来准确，这女人手上的相机、头发、身高、穿着，该是刚刚那名差点被冲撞而被他护在怀中的女人无误，虽然她刚刚没有抬起脸来让他瞧，可他很确定方才的她脸上并没有那副黑框眼镜。

所以，她是故意的？为了避开谁呢？

“齐藤先生？”左语恩久久等不到对方回答，只好微微提了声。“关于刚刚我问到你和蓝琳小姐的关系，不知您方不方便回答？”

齐藤英树的黑眸终于转回到左语恩那娇小的脸上，这应该是他第一次认真地正视她，而他发现了一件有趣的事，就是她鼻梁两侧有长期戴眼镜的痕迹……

他倾身向前，压低了嗓音问：“你的眼镜是否刚刚借给了那位帮我摄影的小姐？”

“咦？”左语恩吓一跳，愣住了。

他给了她一个极具个人魅力的微笑。“如果你回答我的问题，我就回答你的问题。”

“是……你怎么知道？”这也太诡异了！

“猜的。她为什么要借你的眼镜？”

左语恩柔柔一笑。“齐藤先生为什么对这个有兴趣？”

“你如果不想回答我这个问题，那就回答我下个问题——她叫什么名字？”

“原来，齐藤先生是对我们家席舞有兴趣？”

齐藤英树挑了挑眉，再次看向那女人。“席舞？她的名字？”

“是。”左语恩点点头。“我已经回答齐藤先生两个问题，所以，也请你遵守承诺。”

齐藤英树淡笑，很爽快地回答她。“我和蓝琳小姐是纯合作关系，但未来不排除任何的可能性，就看缘分。”

“所以，齐藤先生现在和蓝琳小姐并不是男女朋友或是婚约关系？”

“我刚刚说了，是纯合作关系。”

第12章(2)

左语恩点点头，把他说的话打进电脑里，却抬眸一笑。“这是官方回答吧？不能给我个独家报导吗？譬如你过去的恋情或喜欢的女人类型等等，这些大家比较爱听的八卦内容？”

“如果你可以出去让我单独跟席舞小姐聊一下，或许我会考虑的。”他的过去只有一个女人，那就是舞冬末。这个叫席舞的，不管是发香、身形和气质都很有舞冬末的感觉，只是比以前成熟了些——不管怎样，他都必须亲自再次确认不可，任何的可能性他都不想放过。

“为什么？齐藤先生看起来不像是花心风流又冒失之徒。”左语恩不得不问。

她超级灵敏的直觉告诉她，不管是他的气质谈吐还是优雅举止，都很难跟刚刚他言语中带出的轻狂联想在一块。对于一个初见面的女人表现出如此积极的兴趣，怎么看都不像是传言中冷漠寡言的齐藤社长呵。

齐藤英树却只是轻轻扯唇。“如果你不愿意帮忙也无妨，如果等一下某人闹失踪，你别忙着去警局报案就好。”

天啊，他想绑架？难道外传齐藤家背后有日本黑帮撑腰，果真是事实？

左语恩瞪大了眼，忙不迭站起身，转头突然对某个依然很努力躲在相机后头的女人大叫——

“席舞快跑！有人要抓你！快！”

席舞一愣，一张戴着黑框眼镜的脸终于从相机后头移出来。

只见齐藤英树那张俊颜在一阵诧然之后，是憋不住的笑，似乎完全没想到左语恩这女人的反应是这样。

“快走啊，他要绑架你，你还愣在那边干什么？”而左语恩则是拼了命地朝她挥手，看她动也不动，只好跑到她面前拉她。“你快走，我来挡住他！”

“嗄？语恩……”现在究竟是什么状况？她完全没弄明白啊。席舞莫名其妙地看着正起身朝她走来的男人。

“跟我谈谈吧，席舞小姐。”齐藤英树开门见山地说，盯住她的黑眸专注而深幽。“不然我真的会绑架你。”

齐藤英树要绑架她？

如果他真的想要这么做，现在要跑也来不及了好吗？

专访所用的饭店房内，只剩下席舞和齐藤英树，左语恩被赶出去了，席舞要她先回家，她却坚持要守在门口。
content_en:
"It's just a piece of cake."

She opened her mouth half-frightened."I know, but I just don't like it."

Saito Hideki smiled lightly and did not continue on this topic.

Lan Lin looked at him, but she wasn't stupid enough to get entangled. She just liked Saito Hideki's cold and indifferent tone. She still looked down upon a man who promised and flattered him in every possible way, especially now that their relationship was nothing. She hooked his hand, but he didn't get rid of her, so she snickered.

On the other side, Xi Wu found Zuo Yuen and said straight away: "Lend me your glasses!"

Zuo Yuen handed over the water."Why suddenly..."

"Because I met an acquaintance I didn't want to meet." Xi Wu took the water and drank it, looking at the black-rimmed glasses on Zuo Yuen's face."Look carefully, your glasses don't have prescription, right? They should be good for covering your face. Can you lend them to me? Otherwise, I'm going to get away from people. I'm sorry I can't help you during the interview."

"So heartless..." You already know how important this interview is, and you still want to avoid him?It seemed that Xi Wu had really met an acquaintance whom she really didn't want to see, and Zuo Yuen couldn't say no at all.As he muttered, he reached out and took off the glasses on his face."Here, here you go."

"Thank you." Xi Wu took it with a smile, suddenly glanced at her, and his eyes widened suddenly."Oh my God, Yu En, you are very beautiful, and your eyes are seductive...well..."

Zuo Yuen sealed her mouth with his hand."Shh, don't talk nonsense."

Xi Wu took her hand off her mouth."I'm not telling you nonsense. You are really beautiful. Tsk, those eyes will probably make a man fall in when he sees them, right?"

"Still talking!" Zuo Yuen stamped his feet."Give me my glasses! I won't lend them to you anymore!"

She stretched out her hand to grab it, but Xi Wu turned around to hide and quickly put the glasses on her face."It's too late, it already belongs to me today, unless you want your interview photos to be open, I'm serious!"

Zuo Yuen didn't stop after hearing this, but turned Xi Wu around to take a look."It looks similar. Are you sure people won't recognize it this way?"

"I will try my best to hide behind the camera. If you don't pay attention, you won't see it." Xi Wu smiled faintly and adjusted his glasses awkwardly."I have an extra pair of glasses. It really gives me a little more sense of security. No wonder you always wear glasses and you look so beautiful. Are you afraid of attracting flies?"

Zuo Yuen blushed with embarrassment."How beautiful is it? It's just that you usually think that I am ugly, so you were very surprised when you saw me. But you, what happened just now? Why did your face suddenly turn pale? Are you feeling better now?"

Xi Wu nodded, not wanting to explain anything, and smiled at her."I suddenly had chest pain just now. It's much better now. It's okay. Don't worry."

"If it's okay, then go to work. I'll trouble you today."

"Just remember to treat me to a big dinner." Xi Wu patted her with a smile on her face, but she was extremely nervous in her heart. Her heart was pounding and even her palms were sweating.

Will he recognize her?

Probably not...

She really doesn’t have to scare herself…

The signing ceremony went very smoothly. He just signed his name, took the microphone and said some scripted remarks to the media, and took photos so that everyone could go back to work. Saito Hideki was very familiar with this. Although he didn't like it, he could handle it with ease.

The exclusive interview after the cocktail party was arranged for him by Lan Lin. It is said that this business magazine is published at home and abroad, and is quite famous and credible in Taiwan and mainland China. He will agree that this interview is for the promotion and marketing mechanism of the cooperation between the two Chinese and Japanese consortiums. It is better to leave it alone than to waste it.

However, he seemed very absent-minded during the interview because his eyes were always attracted by the woman holding a camera not far away——

Big black-framed glasses, bangs that almost covered half of her face... In the blink of an eye, this woman seemed to be deliberately making herself ugly. Why?

His eye for identifying people has always been accurate. The camera, hair, height, and clothing of this woman must be the woman who was almost hit and protected in his arms just now. Although she did not raise her face for him to see, he was very sure that she did not have the black-rimmed glasses on her face just now.

So, she did it on purpose?To avoid whom?

"Mr. Saito?" Zuo Yuen couldn't wait for the other party to answer for a long time, so he had to raise his voice slightly."As for the question I just asked about your relationship with Miss Lan Lin, I wonder if it would be convenient for you to answer?"

Saito Hideki's dark eyes finally turned back to Zuo Yuen's petite face. This must be the first time he looked at her seriously, and he discovered an interesting thing, that is, there were traces of wearing glasses for a long time on both sides of her nose...

He leaned forward, lowered his voice and asked, "Did you just lend your glasses to the lady who took my photo?"

"Huh?" Zuo Yuen was startled and froze.

He gave her a charming smile."If you answer my question, I'll answer your question."

"Yes...how do you know?" This is too weird!

"Guess. Why did she want to borrow your glasses?"

Zuo Yuen smiled softly."Why is Mr. Saito interested in this?"

"If you don't want to answer my question, then answer my next question - what's her name?"

"It turns out that Mr. Saito is interested in our Xiwu?"

Saito Hideki raised his eyebrows and looked at the woman again."Xi Wu? Her name?"

"Yes." Zuo Yuen nodded."I have already answered Mr. Saito's two questions, so please keep your promise."

Saito Hideki smiled lightly and answered her readily."Miss Lan Lin and I have a purely cooperative relationship, but we don't rule out any possibility in the future. It just depends on fate."

"So, Mr. Saito and Miss Lan Lin are not boyfriend and girlfriend or engaged?"

"I just said, it's a purely cooperative relationship."

Chapter 12(2)

Zuo Yuen nodded and typed what he said into the computer, then raised his eyes and smiled."Is this an official answer? Can't you give me an exclusive report? For example, your past relationships or the type of women you like, etc. These are the gossips that everyone likes to hear?"

"If you can go out and let me talk to Miss Xi Wu alone, maybe I will consider it." There was only one woman in his past, and that was Wu Dongmo.This person named Xi Wu, in terms of hair, body shape and temperament, has the feeling of Wu Dongmo, but he is more mature than before - no matter what, he must confirm it again in person, he does not want to let go of any possibility.

"Why? Mr. Saito doesn't look like a carefree and reckless person." Zuo Yuen had to ask.

Her super sensitive intuition told her that whether it was his temperament, conversation or elegant behavior, it was difficult to associate it with the frivolousness in his words just now.Showing such active interest in a woman he met for the first time does not look like the cold and taciturn President Saito rumored to be.

Saito Hideki just pulled his lips lightly."It's okay if you don't want to help. If someone goes missing later, just don't rush to the police station to report the case."

Oh my god, he wants to kidnap?Is it true that there are rumors that the Saito family is backed by Japanese gangsters?

Zuo Yuen's eyes widened, he stood up in a hurry, turned around and suddenly shouted to a woman who was still trying hard to hide behind the camera——

"Xi Wu, run! Someone is trying to catch you! Hurry!"

Xi Wu was stunned for a moment, and a face wearing black-rimmed glasses finally came out from behind the camera.

I saw Saito Hideki's handsome face couldn't hold back a smile after a moment of surprise. It seemed that he didn't expect the woman Zuo Yuen to react like this.

"Come on, he's going to kidnap you, why are you standing there?" Zuo Yuen waved to her desperately, and seeing that she couldn't move, he had no choice but to run in front of her and pull her."Go quickly, I'll stop him!"

"Huh? Yu En..." What is the situation now?She didn't understand it at all.Xi Wu looked at the man who was getting up and walking towards her inexplicably.

"Talk to me, Miss Xiwu." Hideki Saito said straight to the point, staring at her with focused and deep black eyes."Otherwise I will really kidnap you."

Saito Hideki wants to kidnap her?

If he really wants to do this, it's too late to run away now, okay?

In the hotel room used for the interview, only Xi Wu and Saito Hideki were left. Zuo Yuen was kicked out. Xi Wu asked her to go home first, but she insisted on guarding the door.
